text: Siftor nde Annabi-yo o his-heerirani hafsa kabaaru, ina e hembo wonde O ɓadataako cuddiiɗo makko Maariya, hafsa haalani aa*isa kabaaru o, Alla anndini annabi makko saaktaade sirru o, O feli hafsa O haalani mbo yogo e yeewtere he o fanki ko heddii ko, hafsa wi*i Mbo hombo haalan ma o kibaaru? O maaki habrii kam Gannda kala huunde kumpatiiɗo kala ko wirni.
